prose.text: The App Connector group is the unit that holds connectors together: it carries the enrollment association, the update schedule, DNS option and location.

prose.label: Membership.
prose.text: {{every-connector-one-group}} {{groups-for-ha}} {{segment-server-group-chain}} What happens with a missing association is unsourced {{gap:unassociated-group-behavior}}. {{managed-read-only}}

prose.label: Enrollment certificate and user codes.
prose.text: [[zpa.terraform.group-enrollment:resolver-lookup-by-name]] {{ansible-resolves-cert}} The Python SDK documented this behavior without doing it up to v1.11.1 {{divergence:python-cert-docstring-vs-code}} and does the lookup from v1.11.2 {{python-cert-auto-lookup}}; what the API does with a create that omits the certificate is still open {{gap:create-missing-cert-error}}. {{provider-verifies-user-codes}} The same verification step for other group types is in [[zpa.terraform.resource-fidelity]].

prose.label: Tooling fields.
prose.text: {{python-model-group-fields}} An unverified claim about members blocks drifting in Terraform is {{gap:group-connector-blocks-drift}}, and the July 2026 console change is {{served-from-edit-july16}}

Provider lookup and delete behavior for groups is in [[zpa.terraform.data-source-selection]] and [[zpa.terraform.delete-paths]]. Update scheduling is in [[zpa.app-connectors.upgrades]]; the enrollment methods are in [[zpa.app-connectors.enrollment]].

The group flags praEnabled, wafDisabled and lssAppConnectorGroup default to false in the Python model (lssAppConnectorGroup is None when no response is given) and are described by the API reference {{group-flag-defaults}}.
The three TCP Quick ACK flags must be set to the same value {{tcp-quick-ack-same-value}}.
A group can carry a Network Protection assistant group with LAN subnets and DNS NS records {{np-assistant-group-model}}.
Coordinates differing beyond the sixth decimal produce no Terraform diff {{tf-coordinates-six-decimals}}.
The contract and the Python docstring agree on the DNS query values: {{dns-query-type-contract-values}}
The group coordinates are strings with a range check: {{latitude-longitude-string}}
A direct Go update with no certificate ID sends no certificate key: {{go-update-no-cert-lookup}}
The Go test creates groups with an explicit Connector certificate: {{go-test-sends-connector-cert}}
The MCP tool resolves the certificate before it calls the SDK: {{mcp-create-resolves-cert}}
Whether the API rejects a create without the certificate, and under which name, is open {{gap:create-missing-cert-error}}.

The three TCP quick acknowledgement flags must be equal, and the Terraform resource enforces that itself before calling the API [[zpa.terraform.resource-constraints:quick-ack-flags-checked-by-provider]].

every-connector-one-group.statement: Every App Connector belongs to exactly one App Connector group, and a group should always be associated with at least one OAuth 2.0 enrollment token or provisioning key and one server group to serve any application.

quotes: Every App Connector belongs to a specific App Connector group, and every App Connector group should always be associated with at least one OAuth 2.0 enrollment token or provisioning key and one Server group to serve any application.
each App Connector must belong to a single group.

groups-for-ha.statement: Zscaler recommends deploying App Connectors in groups for high availability and horizontal scaling, per region or functional area, and an existing group can take a new connector without creating a new group.

quotes: Zscaler recommends deploying App Connectors in groups for high availability and horizontal scaling.
Group App Connectors per region or functional area; each App Connector must belong to a single group.
You do not need to create a new App Connector group every time you add an App Connector.

group-settings.statement: A group sets the automated update schedule for an off-hours window, the preferred local version profile, and the location used in application path selection.

quotes: If not set, the provider will automatically look up the "Connector" enrollment certificate by name and populate this attribute for you.

unassociated-group-behavior.title: What happens to a group with no server group
unassociated-group-behavior.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "App Connector Group must associate with both a Server Group AND a provisioning key to serve any traffic. A group with no Server Group association silently fails to route traffic - the admin console doesn't flag the partial config as invalid." The help says a group should always have both associations; it does not say what the console or the data path does when one is missing.

group-connector-blocks-drift.title: Group resources omitting a members block
group-connector-blocks-drift.detail: Unverified legacy statement about service_edge_group from issue #550 (Service Edge Group service_edges block drift) ends: "The same pattern likely applies to App Connector Groups when an app_connector_groups block is omitted but the group has registered connectors - though this is not documented in the issue thread." The issue is not a registered source and nothing was read for an App Connector Group members block.

edit-from-served-from-view.title: Editing groups from the application-serving view
edit-from-served-from-view.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Group editing from application-serving context became available on July 16, 2026: App Connector groups can be edited from the 'Where are my apps being served from?' view to resolve unknown hosting or location details." The captured July release summary holds only an introduction.
edit-from-served-from-view.resolution: The release summary lists the July 16, 2026 update (claim served-from-edit-july16).

create-missing-cert-error.title: What the API returns when a group create has no enrollment certificate ID, and under which name
create-missing-cert-error.detail: The update path is covered: the ZPA provider's 4.4.10 changelog says resolving the certificate on update prevents a missing.mandatory.params API error when the attribute is empty in state, and its update code comments that the API requires enrollmentCertId on update. Open is the create path and the field name. Unverified legacy statement: an authenticated Go SDK integration run on a production tenant is reported to have had its App Connector Group POST rejected with 400 missing.mandatory.params because the API's signingCertId was empty, while the legacy Help field table lists no certificate field and the Go client serializes the field as enrollmentCertId. The only record is the repository's authored note vendor/zscaler-help/zpa-create-operation-drift-capture.md, which static-captures.json classes as a note that cannot be cited as evidence. On the SDK side, up to Python SDK v1.10.0 the docstring and the code disagreed (python-cert-docstring-vs-code); from v1.11.2 the SDK fills in the certificate itself and its changelog calls `enrollment_cert_id` required (python-cert-auto-lookup), so an SDK create no longer omits it. Create a group without a certificate in a scratch tenant and record the status, the message and the field it names.
create-missing-cert-error.blocks: treating enrollmentCertId as required for every group create
